after: Step on the switch behind me. The final bridge leads to Ryuga.

name: Ryuga
intro: Dragons do not fear the dusk. They own it.
defeat: Ha! The twilight bows to you today.
after: Your wings are strong. Fly high, and never let the dusk swallow your light.

name: Morrow
intro: Welcome, challenger. I am Morrow. The departed whisper your name... and they whisper it with pity.
defeat: The spirits fall silent. How rare. How wonderful.
after: Go on. The spirits will watch your back.

name: Ferrum
intro: Ferrum. I forge steel, and steel forges me. Let's see what you're made of.
defeat: Tempered and true. You are made of strong stuff.
after: The next room belongs to Sibyl. Do not let her get inside your head.

name: Sibyl
intro: I am Sibyl. I have already seen how this battle ends. Shall we find out if I was right?
defeat: I saw it wrongly. For the first time in years... I am glad.
after: Nox waits beyond. He is gentler than he looks. Usually.

name: Nox
intro: Nox. Most challengers flinch at the dark. You don't. Good. Now let's see you shine.
defeat: There it is. The light that broke Team Eclipse.
after: The Champion is waiting. She has been waiting for someone like you.

name: Celeste
intro: Hello, {player}. I watched you on the summit. Now show me that light up close.
defeat: Brilliant... You are the brightest star I have ever faced.
after: Tessera has a new Champion.

name: Celeste
intro: Hello, {player}. I watched you on the summit. Now show me that light up close.
defeat: Brilliant... You are the brightest star I have ever faced.
after: Tessera has a new Champion.

name: Celeste
intro: Hello, {player}. I watched you on the summit. Now show me that light up close.
defeat: Brilliant... You are the brightest star I have ever faced.
after: Tessera has a new Champion.

name: Abel
intro: Route 13 just reopened and I've been waiting all week for a real opponent!
after: Victory Road has a waterfall you'll have to climb. Bring a strong swimmer.

name: Iris
intro: The highland air does wonders for my Pokémon's coats. And their tempers!
after: Milotic are said to live in the Victory Road lake. Gorgeous, aren't they?

name: Garm
intro: I trained in Dragonspire for years and never beat Ryuga. You did? Prove it!
after: Dragons sulk when they lose. Mine is sulking very loudly right now.

name: Wade
intro: Shh! The Skyfall trout are biting! ...Fine, a quick battle.
defeat: There goes my catch AND my battle.
after: Super Rod, highland river. That's where the big Gyarados hide.

name: Nell
intro: Brr! This tarn is freezing! Battle me so I can warm up!
after: There's a little island in the middle. I found a PP Max there once. Or was it a rock?

name: Hale
intro: Every challenger walks this road. Few walk back with a Championship.
defeat: You might be one of the few.
after: Rest at the lodge before Victory Road. The keeper's tea fixes everything.

name: Tov
intro: Ranger on duty! Let's see if you can handle the highland wild.
after: Victory Road is a three-floor climb. Strength and Waterfall, both. Pack accordingly.

name: Ysa
intro: I'm warming up for the Elite Four. You're my warm-up!
defeat: Okay, maybe I need a longer warm-up.
after: Morrow, the first Elite, uses Ghost-types. Pack Dark moves.

name: Bren
intro: Welcome to Victory Road! The last road. The hardest road!
defeat: Okay, maybe not that hard for you.
after: The waterfall is the only way up. Surf the lake and climb!

name: Lia
intro: This cave has turned back hundreds of trainers. Will you be number hundred-and-one?
after: If you can't climb the falls yet, you need a Pokémon that can learn Waterfall and seven Badges.

name: Goro
intro: HYAAH! Victory Road builds strong legs! And strong fists!
defeat: My fists are tired. My legs too.
after: I've climbed that waterfall barehanded. Don't try it. Use a Pokémon.

name: Ena
intro: I sensed you'd drop down that ledge. Now sense THIS!
after: The ledge is a shortcut down. Handy if you need to go back to the Center.

name: Rook
intro: You climbed the falls! Few get this far. Fewer get farther!
after: The ladder is to the west. Upstairs, boulders block the way.

name: Crag
intro: Boulders! Boulders everywhere! I love it!
defeat: I love it slightly less now.
after: Push the boulder in that gap east. Strength makes it easy.

name: Vale
intro: Pushing boulders AND battling? You're multitasking!
after: There's a breakable rock on the east wall. Treasure behind it, probably.

name: Drake
intro: My name is Drake and I train dragons. Yes, I've heard every joke!
defeat: That one was new, at least.
after: The ladder up is in the far corner of this chamber.

name: Osk
intro: I've made it to the League five times. You'll make it zero times if I win!
defeat: Six for me, one for you. Wait, that's not how it works.
after: Ferrum's Steel-types are tough. Fire and Ground moves help.

name: Rue
intro: This gallery has the prettiest crystals in all of Victory Road. Admire them later!
after: Sibyl, the third Elite, is a Psychic. Her Pokémon grow huge in the League's power spot.

name: Zed
intro: The exit is close. But I'm closer!
after: Your rival went through here an hour ago. They looked nervous.

name: Nova
intro: I'm the last real challenge before the plateau! Probably!
after: Nox, the fourth Elite, uses Dark-types. Fighting and Fairy moves shine.

name: Mara
intro: Thirty years of battling, and I still get butterflies here. Let's battle!
after: The Champion, Celeste, adapts. She'll use whichever power fits the battle.

name: Onn
intro: The crystals hum with the Prism's light again. You restored it. Now show me your strength.
defeat: A strength worthy of the light.
after: Necrozma devours light only when it is starved. Thanks to you, it will rest.

name: {rival}
intro: This is it. The last battle before the League. Everything I've got!
defeat: ...Yeah. You're the real deal. You always were.
after: Go win it all. For both of us.

name: {rival}
intro: This is it. The last battle before the League. Everything I've got!
defeat: ...Yeah. You're the real deal. You always were.
after: Go win it all. For both of us.

name: {rival}
intro: This is it. The last battle before the League. Everything I've got!
defeat: ...Yeah. You're the real deal. You always were.
after: Go win it all. For both of us.

name: Basalt
intro: The pass is steep, the air is thin, and I'm feeling feisty!
defeat: Out of breath. Out of Pokémon.
after: Summit caves glitter, but watch your step. Eclipse left crates everywhere.

name: Wyn
intro: Ryuga let you through? Then let's see if he was right!
after: Clan scouts are tracking Eclipse up to the summit. Hurry!

name: Grunt
intro: Rear guard of Team Eclipse! Nobody follows the lens!
defeat: The lens... is probably fine without me.
after: Lord Umbra's already climbing. You're too late!

name: Grunt
intro: Halt! This canyon is closed for, um, eclipse maintenance!
after: The summit caves are full of our people. Turn back while you can.

name: Cass
intro: I patrol this pass. Prove you're not with those Eclipse creeps!
after: The tarn has an islet with something shiny on it. Bring a Surfer.

name: Lune
intro: The stars are hiding. Something up there is drinking their light...
defeat: Your light is still bright, at least.
after: When the Prism Pokémon wakes, it will be hungry. Be ready.

name: Dax
intro: Last stretch before the caves. Last chance to impress me!
after: The cave mouth is just south. Good luck up there.

name: Grunt
intro: Intruder in the crystal halls! Sound the alarm! ...Fine, I'll just battle you.
after: We cleared a path to the summit with those crates. Science!

name: Grunt
intro: These crystals are worth a fortune! And they'll power the eclipse forever!
after: Admin Vesper is upstairs. She can see the future. Supposedly.

name: Grunt
intro: You again?! I saw you in Voltara! And Mt. Prism! Do you ever take a day off?
after: Lord Umbra says when the eclipse comes, nobody will ever squint again. Inspiring!

name: Hex
intro: The Umbral Lens is my masterpiece! It will drink the Prism's light like a sponge!
defeat: My calculations... did not include you.
after: Once the lens is charged, Necrozma's light belongs to Team Eclipse. Theoretically.

name: Grunt
intro: I'm guarding the pretty pool! Off-limits!
defeat: Fine. It's not even that pretty.
after: There's something on that little islet. I can't swim, so... yeah.

name: Grunt
intro: Second floor, second line of defense! I'm the line!
after: Don't wake Admin Vesper's Pokémon. They don't sleep anyway.

name: Grunt
intro: Shh! The lens is humming. Isn't it beautiful? Now go away!
after: Vesper's corridor is north. Bring something that hits Ghosts hard.

name: Mor
intro: I joined Eclipse for the free robes. I stayed for the dramatic lighting.
defeat: The lighting was not in my favor.
after: Vesper reads futures. Mine said 'loses to a kid'. Rude, but accurate.

name: Grunt
intro: Nobody gets near Admin Vesper. Nobody!
after: Fine. She's right through there. Don't say I didn't warn you.

name: Vesper
intro: I foresaw this moment, child. In every future, you fall.
defeat: This... was not in any vision.
after: Futures can change, it seems. How very inconvenient.

name: Grunt
intro: Your friend is holding the stairwell? Cute. I'm holding THIS one!
after: Admin Corvin is in a VERY bad mood. He hasn't forgotten Mt. Prism.

name: Grunt
intro: The summit is right above us. You'll never see it!
after: Corvin's waiting in the west corridor. Tell him I tried.

name: Grunt
intro: I was told to guard this dead end. Is it a dead end? I've been here for days.
after: If Lord Umbra wins, do we get overtime? Nobody tells me anything.

name: Corvin
intro: You. The light-bearer who embarrassed me on Mt. Prism. This time the darkness wins.
defeat: Again?! How is your light still this bright?
after: Go, then. Lord Umbra will extinguish you himself.

name: Umbra
intro: Look around you, child. The Prism's light is ours. Soon the sun itself will hide.
after: Light always casts a shadow. Remember that.

name: Hazel
intro: The little sprout grew up! Let's see how tall.
defeat: Goodness, you've grown into a mighty oak.
after: Every garden needs a storm now and then. Thanks for the rain!

name: Marina
intro: The tide always comes back, Champion. So do I!
defeat: Swept out to sea... and I loved every second.
after: Come back when the tide turns. It always does.

name: Volta
intro: Encore! The crowd demanded a rematch, superstar!
after: That show sold out. Literally, my wallet's empty.

name: Garnet
intro: Bedrock, eh? Let's see if you've eroded since!
defeat: Not a crack in you. Solid granite.
after: Next time I'm bringing a bigger drill.

name: Elowen
intro: The mist has missed you, little star.
defeat: Such light... the veil could never hold you.
after: Shine on. The mist will always remember you.

name: Blaise
intro: The forge is still hot, Champion. Let's reheat that rivalry!
defeat: Tempered steel! You're forged for this.
after: Ashfall's fires never go out. Neither will this rematch.

name: Isolde
intro: The ice remembers every footstep. Yours left cracks. Let's mend them.
defeat: A thaw... in the middle of winter.
after: Frostmere's snow will wait for your return.

name: Ryuga
intro: Dragons sleep long and wake hungry. So do I.
after: Dragonspire's flame burns for you now, Champion.

name: Morrow
intro: Back from the other side, are we? Splendid. So am I.
defeat: Ah... the veil parts for you once more.
after: The dead are patient. I can wait for another round.

name: Ferrum
intro: Steel doesn't rust, Champion. It hardens. Let me show you.
defeat: Bent... but never broken. Well done.
after: I'll reforge every plate of armor for next time.

name: Sibyl
intro: I foresaw this rematch the day you won. I foresaw the outcome too... perhaps.
defeat: The future is never fixed. Yours shines brightest.
after: Come again. I'll pretend to be surprised.

name: Nox
intro: Team Eclipse dreamed of endless night. I simply live in it. Shall we?
after: Night always returns. So will I.

name: Celeste
intro: The crown sits well on you. But a crown must be defended. Show me, Champion!
defeat: Radiant. Truly radiant. Tessera chose well.
after: Whenever you wish to dance again, I'll be waiting under the light.

name: {rival}
intro: Champion or not, I'm still gunning for you!
defeat: Ha... still the best. One day, {player}. One day.
after: Rematch whenever. I'll be here, training like crazy.

name: {rival}
intro: Champion or not, I'm still gunning for you!
defeat: Ha... still the best. One day, {player}. One day.
after: Rematch whenever. I'll be here, training like crazy.

name: {rival}
intro: Champion or not, I'm still gunning for you!
defeat: Ha... still the best. One day, {player}. One day.
after: Rematch whenever. I'll be here, training like crazy.

name: Mara
intro: A Champion on Route 14? Prove it!
after: The Tower Tycoon is even scarier than me. Good luck.

name: Drake
intro: The isles are where Champions come to be humbled!
after: Dragon-types are everywhere out here. Stock up on Ice moves.

name: Kai
intro: This jungle is my beat. Let's see your stuff!
after: Grass hides the rare ones. Night brings out Alolan Rattata and Meowth.

name: Tumo
intro: Whoa! You nearly stepped on my lunch!
after: That glowing den up north hums at night. I don't go near it.

name: Leilani
intro: Dance with me, Champion!
defeat: You stepped on my toes. Figuratively.
after: Oricorio change style with nectar. This one loves pink flowers!

name: Koa
intro: Hii-yah! Island karate!
after: Crabrawler climb trees to reach berries. Inspiring!

name: Ana
intro: The water's warm! Battle in it!
after: The sea between the isles is full of surprises.

name: Noe
intro: Brr! Battle me before I freeze!
after: An iceberg drifts north of here. Something big rests on it.

name: Iris
intro: Cold water keeps my mind sharp!
after: Tempest Isle is straight north. Mind the rain.

name: Finn
intro: I swim laps around Champions!
after: The crag behind me is sealed. A ranger guards it day and night.

name: Mele
intro: Surf's up! Battle's on!
after: My Eiscue's face is an ice cube. It's adorable.

name: Ulu
intro: Shh! You'll scare the fish! ...Fine, let's battle.
defeat: The fish got away AND I lost.
after: Super Rods catch Kingdra here, if you're patient.

name: Bram
intro: Ahoy! Haul anchor and battle!
after: I sail to Tempest Isle on calm days. Never seen a calm day.

name: Rhea
intro: Lightning strikes twice here. So do I!
after: The storm sage studies the legendary birds. He's odd, but kind.

name: Orin
intro: I foresaw your arrival. And my victory.
after: Lugia sleeps under this island. I can feel its dreams.

name: Tasi
intro: Rangers patrol even in this weather!
after: A beast with a thundercloud mane hunts the east meadow.

name: Hoku
intro: I train under the thunder!
after: Electric-types gather here. Bring a Ground-type!

name: Rocco
intro: This cave is MY cave! Well, Lugia's. But mine too!
after: The gale at the bottom ladder... nobody gets through.

name: Selka
intro: The wind down here whispers about you.
defeat: It's whispering about my loss now.
after: They say a Silver Wing calms the storm. Ask the sage outside.

name: Vey
intro: The guardian of the sea dreams. Don't wake it... unless you beat me.
after: Lugia's dreams taste like salt and thunder.

name: Magnus
intro: It's hot! My Pokémon are hotter!
after: Groudon sleeps in the vent. Some nights the whole isle shakes.

name: Pele
intro: Feel the heat, Champion!
defeat: I'm the one who got burned.
after: Moltres circles the summit at dawn. Use the pass in the middle.

name: Ignis
intro: Fire fists! Fire kicks! FIRE!
after: Entei runs through the ash fields like a living wildfire.

name: Ashby
intro: I'm measuring vent temperatures. And your strength!
defeat: Off the charts... the wrong way for me.
after: The shrine maiden tends the volcano. She knows the old legends of land and sea.

name: Ember
intro: Only the strong reach the summit!
after: Moltres doesn't like visitors. Bring Rock moves.

name: Basalt
intro: Rock solid, lava hot!
after: The heat comes from deeper in. From something alive.

name: Vulca
intro: My thermometer just broke. Want to break your streak?
after: Groudon's Red Orb resonates with its ancient power. The maiden keeps it.

name: Kana
intro: The reefs are my playground!
after: South of here is Eclipse Atoll. The altars there are ancient.

name: Loa
intro: Watch out for the jellyfish! ...that's my team.
after: Toxapex are a pain. Bring Psychic or Ground moves.

name: Pua
intro: Isn't my Milotic gorgeous? Let's battle!
after: Feebas are rare, but Milotic sometimes bite a Super Rod here.

name: Mako
intro: My lines are tangled! Battle while I fix them!
defeat: Now my lines AND my nerves are tangled.
after: Dragalge hide in the kelp. Super Rod!

name: Nalani
intro: This reef islet is my training ground!
after: The palm in the middle of the islet hides something.

name: Keoni
intro: Dive in!
after: Cramorant swallow whole Arrokuda. Then spit them at you!

name: Mahina
intro: Beauty is a battle, darling.
after: The Altar of the Moon glows at night. So do I.

name: Hale
intro: Land ho! Battle ho!
after: Dhelmise lurk in sunken wrecks off the atoll.

name: Luna
intro: The moon whispers of a beast with silver wings.
after: Lunala answers only to those who reach the moon altar.

name: Sol
intro: The sun blazes for the lion of dawn!
after: Solgaleo's altar is the northern shrine. It's warm inside.

name: Dawn
intro: Dawn breaks! So will your streak!
after: The warden can awaken Ultra Burst once a sun or moon legend trusts you.

name: Dusk
intro: Darkness suits me. Let's battle!
after: Team Eclipse wanted an endless night. I just like nighttime.

name: Moana
intro: The ocean calls! So do I!
after: A blue beast walks on water near the spring islet. It's beautiful.

name: Tavi
intro: Sharks! Everywhere! Battle!
after: The rocky islet has a cave. The water inside glows blue.

name: Lani
intro: My Wailord is the size of a ferry!
after: The Sky Pillar is east. Nobody's opened its doors in a century.

name: Pono
intro: Reeling in a big one! ...It's you!
after: Relicanth have lived unchanged for a hundred million years. Respect.

name: Kahu
intro: Few reach this islet. Fewer leave undefeated!
after: The Seafloor Cavern holds the Blue Orb's master.

name: Iolana
intro: Splish splash!
after: Swim west to get back to Route 15.

name: Nami
intro: I swam in here and got lost. Battle while I think!
after: The big lagoon... something huge sleeps under the surface.

name: Coral
intro: Kyogre's power fills this place. And mine!
after: Kyogre with the Blue Orb reverts to its primal state. Terrifying!

name: Ryuji
intro: Dragons guard the pillar. I guard the dragons!
after: Rayquaza descends only when sea and land have both been calmed.

name: Tia
intro: One step closer to the sky!
after: The stairs are past the maze. Follow the east wall.

name: Oro
intro: The pillar tests all who climb.
after: Rayquaza ends the quarrel of Kyogre and Groudon. So the old scrolls say.

name: Vega
intro: Only Champions get in here. Let's see if you deserve it.
after: Something in the depths is watching. It's not a friendly feeling.

name: Altair
intro: This grotto is the final test of strength!
after: The Pokémon below was created, not born. Be careful.

name: Jasper
intro: Welcome to the Tower! I'm your warm-up.

name: Opal
intro: Let's make this quick and sparkly!

name: Daichi
intro: Fists of the Tower!

name: Seren
intro: I already know how this ends. Do you?

name: Winston
intro: A gentleman never refuses a duel.

name: Amaryllis
intro: Battle me beautifully.

name: Ronan
intro: Round four. The real Tower starts now.

name: Sabine
intro: I've reached round seven a hundred times. You won't get past me.
defeat: Make that a hundred and one... for you.

name: Thorne
intro: The wild taught me strategy. Let me teach you.

name: Dr. Kepler
intro: My calculations give you a 12% chance. Let's test that.

name: Ishida
intro: Discipline. Focus. Victory.

name: Mirielle
intro: Your streak ends in my dreams. Shall we make it real?

name: Kaito
intro: Round seven. Every challenger meets me sooner or later.

name: Astrid
intro: Seven battles, one ace. That's me.

name: Rafael
intro: One more win and the Tower honors you. If.

name: Aurelio
intro: Twenty victories without a fall. Then you've earned an audience with me. I am the Tycoon. Show me the meaning of a streak!
defeat: Magnificent! The Tower has a new legend.
after: Come back and climb again. I'll be waiting at the top.

name: Cinda
intro: Ashfall's ash is still in my hair. My Pokémon say it suits me!
after: Torkoal puff smoke when they're happy. Mine never stops.

name: Bert
intro: Look how fluffy they are! Okay, now look how strong they are!
after: I comb Wigglytuff every night. It takes an hour. Worth it.

name: Selene
intro: The cavern's crystals made my team shine brighter. Let me show you!
after: Quartz says a Tera Type can turn a weakness into a strength. Think about that before Frostmere.

name: Garn
intro: This is MY crystal vein! Well, I found it first. Probably.
after: Sudowoodo isn't a tree. Don't tell it I said that.

name: Beryl
intro: My instruments say your team is about to lose! My instruments are often wrong.
after: Klinklang's gears hum at the same pitch as the Tera crystals. Coincidence? Yes, probably.

name: Marlo
intro: I swim the bay twice a day! Want to race? No? Battle, then!
after: There's a cave in the cliff of the southwest islet. Divers say a ship's down there.

name: Ondine
intro: The current here is perfect for training. And for battling you!
after: Araquanid carry a bubble of water everywhere. Like a tiny aquarium!

name: Gus
intro: Shh! The fish here are smarter than me. You, too, maybe. Battle!
after: The Halcyon sank in a storm when the sky went black at noon. My dad saw it.

name: Wade
intro: A whole cave lake and nobody fishing it! Except me. And now you.
after: Bruxish grind their teeth so loud the whole grotto echoes.

name: Reef
intro: Careful, the water down here stings. So do my Pokémon!
after: Toxapex sit on the rocks like little crowns. Don't touch them.

name: Lagoon
intro: It's so quiet in here. Let's make some noise!
after: Swim out to the little islets. People drop things there.

name: Coralie
intro: This grotto is a nursery for reef Pokémon. Prove you'll respect it!
after: Golisopod guard the wreck's deck like knights. Very grumpy knights.

name: Mireille
intro: The crew still walks these halls... Can you hear their footsteps? They're angry.
after: The captain's ghost isn't here. He's still alive, you know. He just left his heart on this ship.

name: Brack
intro: Treasure! Gold! Doubloons! ...Or at least a battle!
after: The good loot sank into the hold. It's flooded and pitch black down there.

name: Quill
intro: I served on the Halcyon's sister ship. Show some respect, landlubber!
after: Captain Morrel was the best skipper on the coast. He lives in the Sea Cottage now.

name: Aldous
intro: I collect maritime antiques. You are standing on one. Shall we duel?
after: The captain's log would fetch a fortune. Yet it belongs with the captain, wouldn't you say?

name: Finn
intro: Diving in a dark wreck is the best training! You can't see what's coming!
defeat: I didn't see that coming either.
after: Carracosta lived in shipwrecks long before people built ships. Think about that.

name: Tamsin
intro: The hold's water is full of strange energy. My Rotom loves it!
after: The energy comes from the anchor. Or from what's living in it.

name: Nerissa
intro: Dark, damp and full of ghosts. Exactly my kind of evening!
after: Big Pearls wash up in here. The sea gives back what it takes.

name: Sigrid
intro: Isolde sent me to scout for students! Let's see if you're worth reporting!
after: The ice field has a pattern. Rocks are your friends, walls are your friends. Gaps are not.

name: Lars
intro: Cave boarding! It's like snowboarding, except with more walls!
after: Crabominable climbed all the way up here from the coast. Respect the climb.

name: Tove
intro: Made it across the ice! My legs are jelly but my team is fresh!
after: The ladder goes down to the frozen lake. I'm resting here a while.

name: Astrid
intro: I'm Isolde's top student. Beat me and you might stand a chance against her!
after: Isolde's Lapras can Gigantamax. Its G-Max Resonance sets up Aurora Veil. Break it fast!

name: Aurora
intro: The Power Spot hums through the ice... I've been listening for days.
defeat: The humming stopped. Oh, it's just my ears ringing.
after: Galar particles pool deepest in the den below. Something big sleeps there.

name: Soren
intro: You crossed the frozen lake? Took me a week! Battle!
after: The den ladder is just past me. Bring something that can handle a Gigantamax body slam.

name: Marlstone
intro: Every colour of crystal, all in one cave! I could live here. I might already live here.
after: Somebody's been prying open Quartz's sample crates. Wasn't me. I only lick the crystals.

name: Iolite
intro: Each crystal sings a different note. Yours is off-key. Allow me to tune it!
after: A Pokémon's Tera Type is like a hidden note. You only hear it when it shines.

name: Jasper
intro: I came down here to Terastallize in peace. You'll do as a test!
after: There's a guy in black at the far end hauling a sack. I figured he was a very serious hiker.

name: Opaline
intro: I only wear crystals I find myself. Battle me and I'll show you my favourites!
after: Tinkaton smash crystals with their hammers. Mine is very gentle. Mostly.

name: Grunt Dorran
intro: Retreat? Nobody told ME to retreat! These shards are going to Prism Summit, and so am I. Eventually.
defeat: Okay, okay! Take the sack! It was giving me a backache anyway.
after: Umbra won't even notice I'm late. Right? ...Right?

name: Kelp
intro: I'm mapping the grotto by swimming every inch of it! You're on my map now!
after: The lake is deepest under the wreck. Lanturn light it up at night like lanterns.

name: Bosun
intro: I was a deckhand on the Halcyon, back in the day! I still come to keep her company.
defeat: Ship's bell rings for you, matey.
after: The captain lives at the Sea Cottage. Never talks about the Dark Noon. Maybe you can get him to.

name: Britt
intro: The ridge run is the best slope in Tessera! Battle first, slope later!
defeat: Off-piste and out of the race!
after: The frozen waterfall only thaws for trainers with the Frost Badge. That's what the locals say, anyway.

name: Ike
intro: Ice fishing! You cut a hole, you wait, you freeze. Then you battle passers-by.
after: Walrein come up through the ice holes to breathe. Gave me the fright of my life.

name: Dane
intro: Seven badges? I'm on my way to Ryuga too. Let's see who's readier!
after: Ryuga's dragons can all Terastallize into Dragon type. Pack Ice, Fairy and Dragon moves.

name: Runa
intro: Hiked up here with my whole team in my backpack. My back hurts. Battle!
after: Above the frozen falls there's a cave full of ice. Even hikers turn around there.

name: Cyra
intro: My birds ride the updrafts off the ridge! Watch them dive!
after: Dragons nest on the Roost above Dragonspire. My birds won't fly within a mile of it.

name: Maren
intro: Indoor ice! No wind, no snow, just a perfect slide. And a battle!
after: Slide across the ice for the stone in the middle. Rocks will stop you; nothing else will.

name: Tarn
intro: Swimming in a frozen cave lake keeps you young! I'm actually ninety!
defeat: Okay, I'm thirty. But I feel ninety now.
after: The waterfall at the north end climbs to an upper gallery. There's a ledge to get back down.

name: Ulla
intro: The ice here is thousands of years old! So are my jokes. Battle!
after: Icy Rock makes hail last longer. Isolde swears by it.

name: Kiri
intro: Frigibax hatch in this cave. Keep it down and battle me quietly!
after: Baxcalibur hold their breath underwater for an hour. Their dorsal blade cuts through ice like paper.

name: Halvard
intro: Climbed a waterfall to get here, didn't you? So did I. Let's see whose climb was worth it.
after: I train up here before every League attempt. This year might be the year. Maybe.

name: Vey
intro: The Roost Trail is for Clan pilgrims! Are you a pilgrim? Prove it!
after: The hermit at the top taught Elder Draca everything she knows. And he never lets her forget it.

name: Osric
intro: Fog this thick means the dragons are flying. Better battle before they land on us!
after: Noivern can see through fog with their ears. Echolocation! Mine can't, but it tries.

name: Maeve
intro: Halfway up and I'm out of breath. Not out of fight, though!
after: Rest at the Dragonspire Center before the summit. The hermit doesn't do refreshments.

name: Brann
intro: I carry firewood up to the hermit every week. Today I carry a battle!
after: The hermit's apprentice eats all the snacks I bring. Don't tell him I said that.

name: Isha
intro: My Druddigon has climbed this trail a hundred times. You're new. Let's fix that.
after: Draco Meteor is the Clan's secret technique. Only the hermit teaches it.

name: Cort
intro: I've climbed to the Roost every spring for forty years. Never missed one. Never lost here, either.
after: The year of the Dark Noon, the dragons on the Roost wouldn't stop roaring. I was a boy. I remember.

name: Nim
intro: The air thins, the mind sharpens. Yours is about to be sharpened against mine.
defeat: My mind... is a blunt instrument.
after: The Sky Tablet on the summit hums when the wind blows. I think it's trying to say something.

name: Rhea
intro: You climbed the whole trail? The hermit might actually talk to you. Battle me first!
after: Don't stare at the hermit's eyebrows. He's sensitive about them.

name: Corwin
intro: I came for the hermit's blessing and stayed for the view. And the battles!
defeat: The view's still nice, at least.
after: The founders kept their dragons up here. The statues are older than the city.

name: Sorin
intro: Draca sent you? Then let us see whether she has finally learned to judge character.
after: Draco Meteor spends a dragon's strength in one blow. Use it wisely, and only when it matters.

name: Selka
intro: The Clan asked trainers to watch the pass. I'm watching. Now I'm battling!
after: Haru the scout saw grunts carrying crates into a cave in the west cliff. A second lens, maybe?

name: Oskar
intro: The pass is no place for sightseeing! Unless you can battle. Can you?
after: Eclipse grunts have been using the pass like a highway. Rude highway, too. No waving.

name: Grunt
intro: Whoa, whoa! This is a restricted workshop! Do you have a hard hat? No? Battle!
after: We grind lenses here. The big one's already on the summit. The spare's in the back.

name: Grunt
intro: I've been polishing glass for three weeks. I NEED a battle!
after: The gates to the lab open from the side rooms. Don't tell anyone I told you. I'm bored.

name: Lumen
intro: Light is just energy waiting to be redirected. Your Pokémon, too!
after: A lens doesn't create light, it focuses it. Umbra's focuses darkness. Mostly.

name: Grunt
intro: This switch is MINE. I'm guarding it with my life! Or at least my lunch break!
after: Fine, flip the switch. I'm going to go eat.

name: Obscura
intro: Intruder! The Lens Division will not be disrupted by a child with a Badge Case!
defeat: Disrupted by a child with a Badge Case...
after: Without the backup lens, Umbra has only one chance at the summit. One is all he needs. I hope.

name: Grunt
intro: The chief said nobody gets near the lens. You're somebody, so... battle!
after: The chief designed both lenses. He's very proud. And very bad at losing.

name: Grunt
intro: You made it past the gates? The chief's gonna blame ME for this!
after: Lens number three? Doesn't exist. Budget cuts.

name: Chief Halloran
intro: My beautiful lens! Do you know how long it takes to grind obsidian to a perfect curve? You will not touch it!
defeat: Three years of work... undone by a child.
after: Go ahead, then. Umbra has the first lens. One is all he needs.

name: Kale
intro: You found the secret ladder! Now find out why nobody comes back up smiling!
after: The ice field down there has one clean line through it. I've never found it. I just bounce.

name: Ingrid
intro: You crossed the ice? Then you're worthy of the dragon's treasure. Almost. Battle me!
after: Legend says a Clan founder carved that ice dragon. Legend also says it moves at night. Legend says a lot.

name: Wren
intro: Up here the wind does half the work! My birds just steer!
after: On a clear day you can see Prism Summit from here. Lately it's always dark over there.

name: Aldric
intro: I tend the founders' statues. Show me the respect you'd show them!
after: The statues face Mt. Prism. The founders wanted to keep watch on what sleeps there.

name: Haldor
intro: I punch icicles to train! Today I punch... well, I battle you!
after: Never punch the ice dragon in the depths. I tried. It didn't move. My hand did.

name: Orla
intro: Eight badges and a road to the League. Same as you! Let's find out who goes first.
after: Victory Road has a ladder down on the second floor. The trainers down there are... something else.

name: Bastian
intro: I swim the Skyfall every day. Cold enough to wake the dead! Or at least me.
after: The river comes out of a cave at its north end. Swim up past the bridge if you're brave.

name: Petra
intro: Before the League, a warm-up! For me, I mean. You're my warm-up.
after: Some Eclipse grunts didn't get the memo that it's over. One's camping on the lake islet.

name: Maris
intro: You swam into the grotto? Me too! Let's celebrate with a battle!
after: Climb the inner waterfall and you'll come out in a valley nobody knows about. Well, nobody except me.

name: Tobin
intro: Secret fishing spot! Well, it was secret. Now you know. Battle me to forget!
defeat: I'll never forget this loss, though.
after: Barraskewda bite anything shiny. Including fishing lures. Including my watch.

name: Reza
intro: This is my last training stop before the League. Make it count!
after: Morrow's Gengar knows a Z-Move. Save a Normal or Dark type to take it.

name: Ilse
intro: I lost to the Elite Four nine times. Battle me, and I'll tell you how not to make it ten.
defeat: Well. You won't need my advice.
after: Ferrum's Metagross Mega Evolves. Fire and Ground hit it hardest. That's the advice. You're welcome.

name: Tamsin
intro: My birds followed the river all the way here! Smart birds. Strong too!
after: Some people in black are camping by the old crates on the west side. They look miserable.

name: Nadia
intro: I came here to find the river's source. I found a battle instead. Fair trade!
after: The water up here is so clear you can see the Basculin arguing at the bottom.

name: Gregor
intro: Forty years a trainer and I've never seen this valley. A good day for a battle!
defeat: A good day for a loss, too, it turns out.
after: Sibyl's Hatterene can Gigantamax in the League. Hit it before it walls you.

name: Bodil
intro: The cliffs here go all the way up to Prism Plateau! I'm not climbing them. Battle instead!
after: Nox used to be in Team Eclipse, they say. Now she's Elite Four. People change.

name: Coralyn
intro: The spring pool is the coldest water in Tessera! Brr! Battle!
after: Somebody dropped a capsule on the little islet. I'm too cold to fetch it.

name: Aurel
intro: These depths are where the old champions trained. Only the strongest come down here.
after: Celeste trained in these galleries when she was a kid. Look for her name on the wall.

name: Sasha
intro: Nobody comes down here by accident. So you came looking for a fight. Found one!
after: The rarest items are deeper still. So are the rarest trainers.

name: Kenrick
intro: Ryuga sends his best tamers down here to harden their dragons. Feel the result!
after: A dragon's scale gets tougher with every hit it takes. Mine is very tough now. And sore.

name: Seren
intro: I sense four more battles in your future before the Champion. Five, counting me.
after: Sibyl reads minds. I read faces. Yours says: confident. Keep it that way.

name: Jiro
intro: One hundred battles in the depths! You are number one hundred and one!
defeat: And my first loss down here...
after: Ferrum's Steel types fear my fists. Well, Fighting moves. Not my actual fists.

name: Marisol
intro: I made it to the Champion twice. Celeste beat me twice. Let's see if you'd do better.
after: Celeste only uses one gimmick per battle. You never know which until she does it.

name: Teodor
intro: Rock bottom of Victory Road. Literally. Let's battle like it's the League!
after: Nox Terastallizes. Watch what colour her Pokémon glow before you pick your move.

name: Ondrej
intro: I meditate in the deepest dark to hear the mountain breathe. You're interrupting.
defeat: The mountain has spoken. It said 'ow'.
after: Something below the summit sleeps lighter now. Whatever you did up there, it worked.

name: Magnus
intro: I dug this gallery myself! With help. Mostly Excadrill's help. Battle!
after: There's a group in black hiding in the south chamber. They told me they were spelunkers. In matching outfits.

name: Grunt
intro: The boss lost? So what! Team Eclipse lives on! On this islet. Alone. Please go away.
defeat: Fine! I'll go home! My mom's been texting anyway.
after: The others went deeper. Victory Road and some valley up north.

name: Dr. Vexley
intro: You followed us into the depths? We only need a little light to try again. Just a little!
after: Captain Sable has the last lens fragments. She's in the valley past Skyfall Grotto.

name: Sable
intro: Umbra fell, but I kept the fragments of his lens. With them, Team Eclipse rises again. Starting by putting you down.
defeat: So this is what the boss felt. The light really is too bright.
after: Take the fragments. Tell Calloway I'll come quietly. I'm tired of camping.

name: Lorne
intro: The waterfall's the easy part. The trainers after it are the hard part. Starting with me!
after: Rest at the Highland Lodge if you need to. Pride won't heal your Pokémon.

name: Brigid
intro: So close to the exit I can smell the plateau air. You're not getting there first!
after: Your rival went through an hour ago. They looked nervous. And determined. Mostly nervous.

name: Garrick
intro: Thirty years I've guarded the last stretch of Victory Road. Unofficially. Nobody asked me to.
defeat: Thirty years, and you're the best I've seen. Officially.
after: Celeste was eleven when she beat me. You're about the same age she was. Make of that what you will.

name: Yuna
intro: The deepest gallery is the Clan's oldest training spot. Ryuga trained here. Now I do!
defeat: Ryuga would be disappointed. In me, not you.
after: Draco Meteor is strong, but it drops your Special Attack. Switch out after you use it.

name: Eskil
intro: I patrol this valley so nobody spoils it. You look like you'll behave. Prove it in a battle!
defeat: You behave very well. And battle better.
after: The campers in black haven't hurt anything. They mostly sit around looking sad.
